limitations.description: This release is an explicitly selected subset of the retained Topeka corpus. It establishes the document contract, not collection completeness.
No document here has been ingested through the ExAIS API, embedded, or loaded into a graph. Vector and graph readiness are reported as pending per document.
Released text is extracted source content. It does not establish adoption, legal completeness, effective dates or a final outcome beyond the evidence each record cites.
